content: Rollback/GGPO (SnapNet part 2, coherence docs, Rollback-Core): fixed-step deterministic sim; inputs scheduled with input delay X frames ahead; state saved every frame as one contiguous struct memcpy so restore+re-simulate is cheap; on late/mismatched input restore last valid state and re-simulate forward. Requirement: cheap whole-state save/restore designed in from the start.
